content.text: User Story: As an Editor I want my report to start analyzing automatically after first-time configuration So that I get results without manual intervention.
Story Details: Story ID: Story 3.1 | Feature: N/A | EPIC: EPIC-003
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a report just submitted (status PENDING), When Flink polls every 90s with SKIP LOCKED, Then questions are dispatched to Kafka topics per enabled LLM

Given questions dispatched, When LLM dispatchers send to Prompt API at calibrated rates (OpenAI ~6ms, Claude ~15ms, Gemini ~40ms, Grok ~100ms, Perplexity ~120ms), Then responses are persisted to PostgreSQL first, then published to kafka-responses
Given an LLM call fails after 3 retries, Then response saved with status=FAILED, published to Kafka with status=FAILED, pipeline continues (never blocked)
Given a Circuit Breaker opens for one LLM (>5% errors), Then only that dispatcher pauses 30s, others continue
New module: geo-flink-jobs (separate Maven module, Flink 1.20, Java 21, RocksDB)
Flink checkpoints every 30s
PromptApiClient with 60s timeout, Resilience4j @Retry + Circuit Breaker per LLM
Flyway migrations: llm_responses table (includes nullable snapshot_id column for future Epic 7 snapshot support)
Kafka topics: kafka-questions-{openai,gemini,claude,grok,perplexity}, kafka-responses
Backoff: OpenAI/Grok 500ms->1s->2s, Claude/Gemini/Perplexity 5s->10s->20s

content.text: User Story:
As an Editor I want the system to identify my top competitors from AI visibility results So that competitive analysis uses real market data instead of placeholders.
Story Details:
Story ID: Story 3.3 | EPIC: EPIC-003
Story file:
docs/implementation-artifacts/epics/epic-3/3-3-visibility-enrichment-competitor-discovery.md
Acceptance Criteria
AC1: Consume VISIBILITY_COMPLETE trigger from geo-enrichment-trigger Kafka topic, start enrichment pipeline
AC2: Enrich visibility responses with target_rank, is_mentioned, is_first, total_entities, mentioned_entities (JSONB)
AC3: Brand matching via Gemini AI (2-step: text similarity + AI grouping → normalized_name)
AC4: Extract top 5 competitors per market × category (by mention count desc, avg position asc, penalty rank 11 for absent)
AC5: Replace [Competitor 1-5] placeholders in memory (original templates preserved), dispatch Phase 2 competitive questions to Kafka
AC6: Emit progress events 40→50% via geo-report-status
AC7: Edge cases — zero visibility questions (skip), target brand absent, fewer than 5 competitors, Gemini failure (fallback to text similarity)
Key Decisions
Entity name access: direct DB read from reports table (cross-service read, authorized per architecture)
No write on questions table — placeholder replacement in memory only, final text stored in llm_responses.question_text
Flink Phase 2 counting deferred to Story 3.5 — competitive responses arrive in DB but progress stays at 50%
Competitors extracted in memory (no extracted_competitors table) — recoverable from enriched llm_responses
Definition of Done:
All acceptance criteria met, Unit tests written and passing, Code reviewed and approved.

content.text: User Story:
As an Editor I want AI-generated reputation insights (concepts, sentiment) per category and market So that I understand how AI engines perceive my brand.
Story Details:
Story ID: Story 3.4 | EPIC: EPIC-003
Story file:
docs/implementation-artifacts/epics/epic-3/3-4-perception-analysis-reputation-insights.md
Acceptance Criteria
AC1: Consume PERCEPTION_COMPLETE trigger from geo-enrichment-trigger, call PerceptionEnrichmentService
AC2: 1 Gemini call (gemini-internal) per market × category — extracts concepts with name, response_ids, quotes (text, source_url, sentiment_score)
AC3: Distribute concepts to individual responses via response_ids, store in perception_concepts JSONB
AC4: Stored fields: concept.name, concept.sentiment_score, concept.quotes[]. NOT stored (query-time): frequency, sentiment label
AC5: No progress events (parallel enrichment, not on critical path)
AC6: Edge cases — zero perception responses (skip), Gemini failure (1 retry then skip scope), idempotent on duplicate trigger
PM Decision Required Before Implementation
concept.sentiment_score derivation formula (from quotes[].sentiment_score)
Exact Gemini prompt for concept extraction
Sentiment label thresholds (Positive/Negative/Neutral)
Key Decisions
LLM: gemini-internal (gemini-2.5-flash-lite) — confirmed by MVP code
No progress % events (parallel, independent of critical path)
1 retry per scope, then skip (perception_concepts = null)
Reuses EnrichmentConsumer, LlmResponseRepository, ReportRefRepository from Story 3.3
Definition of Done:
All acceptance criteria met, PM decisions confirmed, Unit tests written and passing, Code reviewed and approved.

content.text: User Story:
As an Editor I want competitive analysis completed and all citation sources classified So that I can see my brand vs competitors and know which publications to target.
Story Details:
Story ID: Story 3.5 | EPIC: EPIC-003 | Last pipeline story (closes the loop)
Story file:
docs/implementation-artifacts/epics/epic-3/3-5-competitive-execution-source-classification.md
Acceptance Criteria
AC1: Flink extends ResponseCounter for Phase 2 competitive counting (50→80% progress)
AC2: Flink emits CLASSIFY_SOURCES when all 3 counts at 100% (visibility + perception + competitive)
AC3: Competitive response enrichment (target_rank, is_first) — 100% local, zero LLM call
AC4: Extract sources from ALL responses (visibility + perception + competitive), create response_sources rows
AC5: 3-level source classification (regex → shared cache → Gemini) with 11 categories
AC6: 11 source categories with priority rules (Brand → Owned, Competitor → Competitor Media)
AC7: Report finalization — Processor publishes PIPELINE_COMPLETE, ReportStatusService evaluates COMPLETED/COMPLETED_PARTIAL/FAILED
AC8: Progress events 50→100% (Phase 2 counting + enrichment + classification + finalization)
AC9-AC10: Edge cases + idempotency (Kafka at-least-once)
Architecture Update
geo-report-status producer: Flink + Processor (was Flink-only)
CLASSIFY_SOURCES added as 4th trigger on geo-enrichment-trigger
Key Decisions
Phase 2 counting: Flink extends ResponseCounter (same pattern as Phase 1)
Competitive enrichment: 100% local, no LLM (competitors already known from Story 3.3)
Source classification on raw response URLs (not enriched data), but needs competitor list for Level 1 priority rules
domain_classifications: cross-tenant shared cache (no organisationId)
3 retries Gemini + regex fallback (.edu→Academic, .gov→Gov, else→Other)
Domain normalization: lowercase, strip www, root domain (from MVP pattern)
Definition of Done:
All acceptance criteria met, Unit tests written and passing, Code reviewed and approved.

content.text: User Story: As an Editor I want improvement areas and priority source targets calculated during the analysis pipeline So that the Actions Center loads instantly with pre-computed results.

Runs after source classification completes, before report status set to COMPLETED
